recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant 1960s-style graphic layout featuring two primary magenta rounded-corner rectangles set against a white background with a blue double-line border. The top section houses bold display typography, while the bottom section utilizes a modular grid of small photographic windows and a large text block for track listings.
coreVisualRelationships: Magenta blocks serve as the primary containers for all content.
Small geometric blue and black squares act as visual anchors between photo frames.
White negative space between the two main magenta blocks creates a horizontal breathing room.
High-contrast white and blue text against the magenta background ensures readability.
coreInvariants: Rounded corners on the main magenta containers.
Double-line blue border framing the entire composition.
Modular grid of square and rectangular photo frames on the left side.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Typography dominates the top third; a mix of imagery and list-based text occupies the bottom two-thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white slab-serif title in the top magenta block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large title, moves down to the artist name, then scans the photo grid on the left before settling on the tracklist on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: White gutters between magenta blocks and white margins around the outer border.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan Blue (Borders and secondary text outlines)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation magenta paired with high-value white for maximum pop.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick, rounded slab serifs with high stroke weight.
Secondary text uses condensed, geometric sans-serif forms.
Outlined text for the artist name to create depth.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Rounded terminals on slab serifs to match container corners.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for impact paired with condensed sans-serif for information density.
graphicDevices: Horizontal white bars flanking secondary text
Modular photo grid with colored filler squares

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded slab serif aesthetic of the main title.
Matches the utilitarian feel of the tracklist and secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a white square canvas with a thin blue double-line border. Place two large magenta rectangles with rounded corners, one on top and one on bottom, separated by a white gap. Inside the bottom rectangle, create a grid on the left with 4-5 small square/rectangular frames, some containing grayscale portraits and others filled with solid cyan or black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large white slab-serif text in the top magenta block. Below it, add condensed sans-serif text in cyan with a thin blue outline. In the right half of the bottom magenta block, add a centered list of text in white condensed sans-serif, framed by two horizontal black bars.

verificationChecks: Is the blue border a double line?
Is the main title a heavy slab serif?
Is the tracklist centered on the right side?

adjustableVariables: Number of photo frames in the grid
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and track titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is cut off by the rounded corners.
Check that the blue outline on the cyan text is visible.
Verify the white gutter between the two magenta blocks is consistent.
Confirm the photo grid uses grayscale or duotone images.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Vibrant Color Blocks] + [Modular Photo Grid] + [Heavy Slab Serif Display Type] + [Double-Line Border Frame] to recreate a 1960s soul/R&B aesthetic.
